title: Well It's Optimized
description: A vanilla optimization modpack and a maintained fork of simply optimized.
body:
A maintained fork of Simply optimized modpack.

## Well It's Optimized
As simple as it sounds, the modpack intends to allow an easy to install modpack to just start minecraft with the best optimization mods available. The modpack does not change or add any content to the game, so you don't need to worry about that.

[![Available on codeberg](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/codeberg_vector.svg)](https://codeberg.org/ZenXArch/WellOptimized) [![Available on modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/zwop) [![Support me on Ko-Fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/I2I31KW58I)

## Goals
Provide quick updates, support latest minecraft versions,
try to maintain vanilla compatibility, speed up minecraft loading, avoiding sketchy mods.

The modpack is intended to be picked up and used by anyone for anything. Even making their own modpacks.

## Changes from Simply Optimized
- Added Structure layout optimizer (a safe optimization mod)
- No Chat restrictions (Because privacy)
- Config manager (I don't think anyone likes having their settings weird when they update their modpack)
